÷ Days owned

Days owned include the purchase day and today, so a purchase made today counts as one day. Calendar days are used, avoiding daylight-saving differences.

Recurring expenses count every payment due up to today, including the first payment. Monthly and yearly payments fall on the same calendar day, or the last day of shorter months.

Your total daily ownership cost is the sum of each item’s daily average. It’s a historical average, not a forecast of today’s bills or depreciation.
